title: Fire damper ratings.
officialText:
Fire dampers shall have the minimum fire protection rating specified in Table 607.3.2.1 for the
type of penetration.
TABLE 607.3.2.1
FIRE DAMPER RATING
MINIMUM DAMPER RATING
(hour)
TYPE OF PENETRATION
Less than 3-hour fire-resistance-rated assemblies 11/
2
3-hour or greater fire-resistance-rated assemblies 3
